aviation_incidents.headline: 路易斯安那州Cessna 210墜毀 飛行員受輕傷
aviation_incidents.summary: 一架Cessna 210於2026年10月13日在路易斯安那州Gonzales起飛後，因引擎在撞地前脫離而墜毀於Louisiana Regional Airport附近田地，機身倒置。74歲飛行員受輕傷，經現場評估後拒絕救護車送院；引擎脫離原因不明。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Cessna 210 crashes in Louisiana after engine separates, pilot has minor injuries
aviation_incidents.summary_en: A Cessna 210 crashed in a field near Louisiana Regional Airport in Gonzales, Louisiana, on October 13, 2026, shortly after takeoff. The engine separated before impact and the aircraft came to rest upside down. The 74-year-old pilot suffered minor injuries and declined ambulance transport after being assessed at the scene. The cause of the engine separation is unknown.

sources.name: AeroTime — Pilot survives Louisiana Cessna crash after engine falls off

aviation_incidents.headline: FAA推出MedGuide 供飛行員與航管人員查詢用藥指引
aviation_incidents.summary: 美國聯邦航空總署推出MedGuide線上指南，供飛行員與空中交通管制員查詢處方藥及非處方藥的使用指引，以及開始用藥或後續服藥後返回值勤前的等待時間。首版僅收錄FAA歸類為可使用的藥物；指南不是個人醫療評估或醫師建議的替代品。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: FAA launches MedGuide for pilots and air traffic controllers to check medication guidance
aviation_incidents.summary_en: The FAA has launched MedGuide, an online tool for pilots and air traffic controllers to check medication guidance and waiting periods before returning to duty. It covers prescription and over-the-counter drugs and gives waiting-period information after starting a medication or taking later doses. The first version includes only medications the FAA categorizes as allowed; the guide does not replace an individual medical assessment or a doctor’s advice.

international_aviation.headline: 法國空天軍在兩座民用機場操作Rafale與CN235
international_aviation.summary: 法國空天軍在BASEX演習期間，依FRA-ACE於Pau Pyrénées及Dinard兩座民用機場部署三架Rafale戰機與兩架CASA CN235運輸機。演習包括CN235訓練飛行、爆裂物處理及與機場消防救援服務的聯合演練；部署經協調以避免干擾正常航班及商業活動。
international_aviation.headline_en: French Air and Space Force operates Rafale and CN235 aircraft from two civilian airports
international_aviation.summary_en: During BASEX, the French Air and Space Force operated three Rafale fighters and two CASA CN235 transport aircraft from Pau Pyrénées and Dinard airports under FRA-ACE. CN235 training included an explosive ordnance disposal exercise and a joint drill with airport fire and rescue services. The deployments were coordinated to avoid disrupting normal flight operations and commercial activity.

international_aviation.headline: 波音執行長10月15日將在薩凡納與美國運輸部長討論認證改革
international_aviation.summary: 波音執行長Kelly Ortberg將於2026年10月15日在喬治亞州薩凡納，與美國運輸部長Sean Duffy及RTX、GE Aerospace高層會面，討論如何簡化航空器、零件及組件的認證流程。美國運輸部表示，認證改革可兼顧飛行安全與航空產業競爭力。
international_aviation.headline_en: Boeing CEO to discuss certification reform with U.S. transportation secretary in Savannah
international_aviation.summary_en: Boeing CEO Kelly Ortberg is due to meet U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy and executives from RTX and GE Aerospace in Savannah, Georgia, on October 15, 2026. Participants will discuss ways to streamline certification of aircraft, parts and components. The Department of Transportation has described certification reform as an opportunity to support flight safety and U.S. aerospace competitiveness.

international_aviation.headline: 阿聯酋航空10月28日至29日在馬尼拉舉辦首次菲律賓飛行員招募活動
international_aviation.summary: 阿聯酋航空將於2026年10月28日至29日在馬尼拉舉辦首次菲律賓飛行員招募巡迴說明會，並與當地機構IPAMS合作。招募對象包括副機長、直聘機長及Accelerated Command Program人選，活動也將介紹資深窄體客機機長直接擔任全寬體機隊機長的招募計畫。
international_aviation.headline_en: Emirates to hold its first Philippines pilot recruitment roadshow in Manila
international_aviation.summary_en: Emirates will hold its first pilot recruitment roadshow in the Philippines in Manila on October 28 and 29, 2026, in partnership with local agency IPAMS. The airline is seeking experienced commercial pilots for first officer and direct-entry captain roles, as well as through its Accelerated Command Program. Sessions will also cover a campaign for experienced narrowbody captains seeking direct command roles on Emirates’ all-widebody fleet.

international_aviation.headline: 漢莎航空首架A350-1000預定12月3日自慕尼黑首航東京羽田
international_aviation.summary: 漢莎航空選定東京作為首架A350-1000的商業首航目的地，預定於2026年12月3日自慕尼黑飛往東京羽田。該機預計於11月中旬交付，航班將配置Allegris客艙；漢莎航空表示，東京首航後數週內，上海與新加坡也將加入目的地網絡。
international_aviation.headline_en: Lufthansa schedules first A350-1000 commercial flight to Tokyo for December 3
international_aviation.summary_en: Lufthansa has selected Tokyo as the destination for the first commercial flight of its first Airbus A350-1000, scheduled to fly from Munich to Tokyo Haneda on December 3, 2026. The aircraft is due for delivery in mid-November and will feature the Allegris cabin. Lufthansa said Shanghai and Singapore will join its destination network in the weeks after the Tokyo launch.

international_aviation.headline: 法國空天軍預計2027年僅接收兩架Rafale 機隊使用率超出規劃
international_aviation.summary: 法國空天軍預計2027年僅接收兩架新型Rafale戰機，同時退役更多Mirage 2000-5；現役作戰飛機使用率已高於原規劃15%以上。參謀長Jérôme Bellanger於2026年10月14日向國民議會國防委員會表示，下一部軍事規劃法應重新檢視法國戰機機隊規模。
international_aviation.headline_en: France’s Air and Space Force expects two Rafales in 2027 as aircraft use exceeds plan
international_aviation.summary_en: France’s Air and Space Force expects to receive only two new Rafale fighters in 2027 while retiring more Mirage 2000-5s. Existing combat aircraft are being used more than 15% above their planned utilization rate. Chief of Staff Jérôme Bellanger raised the fleet-pressure issue at a National Assembly Defense Committee hearing on October 14, 2026, and argued that the next military programming law should reconsider the overall size of the fighter fleet.

international_aviation.headline: SITA同意收購Collins Aerospace機場科技事業 預計2027年上半年完成
international_aviation.summary: 航空運輸資訊科技供應商SITA於2026年10月15日宣布，已同意收購RTX旗下Collins Aerospace的機場科技事業Airport Solutions。交易預計於2027年上半年完成，仍須取得監管機關批准等；財務條件未公開。該事業提供報到、自助服務、行李託運及機場作業系統等科技。
international_aviation.headline_en: SITA agrees to acquire Collins Aerospace Airport Solutions, with deal expected to close in 2027
international_aviation.summary_en: SITA announced on October 15, 2026, that it has agreed to acquire RTX’s Collins Aerospace Airport Solutions business. The deal is expected to close in the first half of 2027, subject to customary conditions including regulatory approvals; financial terms were not disclosed. The business provides airport technology including check-in, self-service and bag-drop systems, as well as operational systems used by airports.
